text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way home after a day
out with
Bamboo Memory...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Isn't that someone from Oguri's
class over
there?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It is!
Hey! A rough crowd hangs out in
that alley! It's
not safe back there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory seems to be familiar
with the
older student, whose hair and
uniform are a mess.
There's an air of grim
determination about her.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You look like a mess! Did you get into a
fight
back there?

text_block_list.name: Disheveled Student
text_block_list.text:
N-no! I was just—wait. What do you
mean I look
like a mess?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I mean... you look like you've been in an
accident
or something!

text_block_list.name: Disheveled Student
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! I'm just trying out a new look!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I see. So you changed your hair and
clothes
to reinvent yourself?

text_block_list.name: Plain Student
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I was tired of being so ordinary. I
wanted
to be the opposite of my usual
self—tough and
flashy.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's not working at all! You know
it's not
good to look disheveled, right?!
It's also against
the academy rules!

text_block_list.name: Plain Student
text_block_list.text:
Um... I... I want to be an amazing
Umamusume,
just like the stars in my
class...
choice_data_list: Why do you want to change so much?
Why do you want to change so much?

text_block_list.name: Plain Student
text_block_list.text:
They're all so charismatic, and everyone
wants
them at events. Each of them
shines like sparkling
idols...

text_block_list.name: Plain Student
text_block_list.text:
Plus, they've got all these passionate
fans who
come from all over to see them.

text_block_list.name: Plain Student
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, I don't have many fans at all.
At this
rate, I'll always just be an
afterthought...

text_block_list.name: Plain Student
text_block_list.text:
I'm plain and boring... Unless I
completely change
myself, I'll never be
in the spotlight!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Plus, I don't think it's
Oguri's looks
that draw everyone to her.
It's how she runs!
choice_data_list: You don't have to put yourself down that much.

text_block_list.name: Plain Student
text_block_list.text:
I train really hard too! But it doesn't
matter how
hard I train, I can't run as
well as everyone else!
I'm plain and
talentless!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But... I'm sure you understand that just
changing
your look isn't going to make
you stand out.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I've been chasing after Oguri too, so I
understand
what it's like to look up to
someone.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But! That's exactly why you can't give up
on
running. You came to Tracen because
you want to
run, right?

text_block_list.name: Plain Student
text_block_list.text: ...I mean, yeah, but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I think you can shine even brighter! Let's
work
together and figure out what
makes you amazing!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
By which I mean, let's do some crazy
red-hot
training! Let's run in the park for
as long as our
legs can carry us!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... You've maintained your form this whole time! It's textbook—dare I say beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Plain Student
text_block_list.text:
Y-you think so? It's not too plain or
ordinary?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Your running is proof of your mastery
over the
fundamentals! That's no easy
feat!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Let's stop here! Although, you haven't slowed down at all. Do you think you can keep going?

text_block_list.name: Plain Student
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Yes, I'm fine. I'm used to just putting my head down and working through things like this...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's some endurance! You've gotta be
pretty
great to keep up with red-hot
training like that!
What's so plain about
that?!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible run, you two! The
way you
kept going lap after lap like
that! You're both
amazing! If you two
enter a race, I'll be there
cheering for
you!

text_block_list.name: Plain Student
text_block_list.text: Oh, um... Thank you...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
See?! You should have more confidence
in
yourself! Right, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
See? Trainer has seen plenty of strong
and
impressive Umamusume, so you
know it's true!
choice_data_list: Let's build on our hard work and shine even brighter!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We'll make sure that you shine nice and
bright!

text_block_list.name: Plain Student
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! That's really reassuring!

text_block_list.name: Plain Student
text_block_list.text:
...I feel a lot better now. Thanks
Bamboo, for not
only training with me,
but also reminding me of
what really
matters.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It's not like Oguri and the
others
started out popular!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Everyone goes at their own pace! If you
keep
getting supporters like that lady
just now, one
day, you'll become the
person you want to be!

text_block_list.name: Plain Student
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... You know what? You're right! I'm
going to
keep plugging away at my own
pace!

text_block_list.name: Plain Student
text_block_list.text:
...I feel a lot better now. Thanks
Bamboo, for not
only training with me,
but also reminding me of
what really
matters.

text_block_list.name: Plain Student
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna continue my training! And I'll
keep on
refining my talents, so that one
day I can shine
like a star too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's a great idea! I'll be cheering for
you!
